args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean, straightforward design, which is great for a personal page. However, I think it could benefit from more content — for example, a short bio about yourself, your interests, projects you're working on, or links to your social profiles. Adding a bit more personality and detail would make it more engaging for visitors. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your favorite hobby is hiking — that's a fantastic theme for a blog! I'd suggest adding some hiking trail reviews, photos from your adventures, or tips for fellow hikers to make the content richer and more engaging. A blog with regular posts about your hikes could really build a nice community of readers. Looking forward to seeing more!
